model_type: Ridge regression with rolling-window walk-forward validation
purpose: Estimate short-term suburb-level market momentum from recent transaction patterns. The model is used as a trend adjustment signal, not as a formal property price forecast.
limitations: Suburb-month sales data is sparse and irregular.
Monthly suburb medians can be noisy due to transaction mix.
Predictions should be interpreted as indicative local market momentum only.
Not suitable for valuation, lending, legal, or investment advice without professional verification.

calibration.reason: Raw Ridge predictions are scaled and clipped at inference time to avoid overreacting to sparse suburb-level transaction data and transaction-mix noise.
